domain_title: Architecture, security, robustness, safety and evaluation
title: Secure and isolated AI architecture
canonical_definition: The system uses defense in depth, explicit trust boundaries and enforced identity, network, environment, tenant, secrets and data-flow controls.

conditions: All AI systems; isolation depth is risk- and stage-dependent.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are assets, identities, data flows, trust boundaries, environments and external connections defined?
Are authentication, authorization, network restriction, secrets isolation and tenant/environment separation enforced?
Do architecture review and technical tests demonstrate that stated boundaries resist unauthorized access and cross-environment movement?

conditions: Refer a material failure of secure and isolated ai architecture to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 4.2 (PDF p. 32), MEASURE 2.7 (PDF p. 35)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on mapping internal component controls and evaluating security and resilience. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make secure and isolated ai architecture verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: D1 evaluates secure and isolated ai architecture using evidence from intent through operation. AP-D1 independently assesses evidence of implicit-trust ai architecture.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a trust-boundary map naming regulated or sensitive assets, actors, identities, tenant and environment connections. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates enforceable identity, authorization, credential isolation, network restrictions and per-environment resource permissions. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides independent architecture review and authorized defensive checks showing denied cross-boundary requests and attributable logging. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in secure and isolated ai architecture, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a trust-boundary map naming regulated or sensitive assets, actors, identities, tenant and environment connections. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate enforceable identity, authorization, credential isolation, network restrictions and per-environment resource permissions. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide independent architecture review and authorized defensive checks showing denied cross-boundary requests and attributable logging. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how secure and isolated ai architecture works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a trust-boundary map naming regulated or sensitive assets, actors, identities, tenant and environment connections. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use independent architecture review and authorized defensive checks showing denied cross-boundary requests and attributable logging to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: A shared underlying service can be permitted when independently enforced tenant and resource isolation is evidenced.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-D1 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in secure and isolated ai architecture
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in secure and isolated ai architecture
Evidence remains insufficient for secure and isolated ai architecture in the assessed scope
